simple.meaning: עֲלָה (ʻălâh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a holocaust.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 1 time across Ezra, beginning at Ezra 6:9. Its contexts include offering, priesthood.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עֲלָה (H5928).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: עֲלָה (ʻălâh) / H5928 is traced through Ezra 6:9 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.full: H5928. alah or alath [ עֲלָת K § 56 , α ) β ) 2] noun feminine burnt-offering (Biblical Hebrew עוֺלָה ; compare Palmyrene עלתא altar , SAC 92 Lzb 341 ); — plural absolute עֲלָוָן Ezra 6:9 .

occurrences.englishText: That which they have need of, including young bulls, rams, and lambs, for burnt offerings to the God of heaven; also wheat, salt, wine, and oil, according to the word of the priests who are at Jerusalem, let it be given them day by day without fail;
